correctness.rationale: For N=30·2^h with h≥0, the exact degree-eight Phi_30 remainder certificate has weights 0 at 0..4 and 15..19 and strictly positive at all positions 5..14. Consequently a nonnegative degree<20 multiple has no coefficients in the central window, and X^15≡−1 (mod Phi_30) forces equality of both degree≤4 outer blocks. Residue-class decomposition modulo 2^h and Phi_(30·2^h)(X)=Phi_30(X^(2^h)) lift the cone identity to all h; monomial removal gives uniqueness. The 1+X^(10t)+X^(20t) witness first breaks antipodal rigidity at diameter 20t. Disjoint antipodal blocks yield the binary counts 1 and 2^(k−1). Independently recomputed Phi_30 and all 20 certificate values and identities for t=1,2,4,8 by exact SymPy arithmetic. Finite certificates support but do not replace the all-h algebra.
